errors.claim: The six deployed parts never call each other directly; they hand work off only through Postgres.
errors.truth: Several parts call each other over HTTP: probes call peer probes (POST /confirm and /report), the app POSTs signed withdraw requests to the edge's /_edge/withdraw, and Caddy on the edge box asks the app's /api/edge/ask before issuing certificates.

errors.claim: 'The probe decides on a verdict' right after its own check and confirmation, then writes the result.
errors.truth: The probe that ran the check only sends the outcome. The monitor's home probe (first in the ranking) computes the verdict inside Store.apply under the row lock. A non-home checker queues the outcome and POSTs it to the home.
